steps.title: Select source
steps.text: Choose Simulation, Becker-Hickl, PicoQuant, or BrickMic. Selecting hardware does not scan or contact it.

await.hint: Choose the source you intend to use.

steps.title: Initialize explicitly
steps.text: Press Initialize device before Start. A missing driver or unavailable card is reported here rather than silently falling back to simulation.

steps.title: Bound the run
steps.text: Keep at least one positive stop condition. Time is wall-clock; photon count is decoded by the live pipeline.

await.hint: Set a time and/or photon limit.

steps.title: Map routing channels
steps.text: These four controls are the pipeline decay-window routing order. Match them to your instrument's channels before starting.

steps.title: Configure simulation
steps.text: For Simulation, Advanced simulation parameters exposes the full actual dictionary and validates it with the simulator engine before applying it.

await.hint: Open and review the advanced simulation parameters.

steps.title: Start and stop
steps.text: Start streams FIFO or encoded simulator records through AcquisitionPipeline. Stop interrupts the active source and flushes its result state.

await.hint: Press Start when the source is initialized.

steps.title: Inspect results
steps.text: Use the real pipeline result tabs and their visibility controls. Clear removes displayed state; Reset does not contact a device.
